channel.title: Olive blog
channel.description: Guides and explainers on Olive, connected DeFi and the CLV to OLV migration.

item.title: What is Olive? The successor to Clover, explained
item.description: Olive is the successor to Clover Finance and Lucent Network, built around a wallet and four connected capabilities. Here is what it offers and who it is for.

item.title: What is connected DeFi? Access, swaps and risk
item.description: Connected DeFi is one access layer for supported networks, protocols and opportunities, built on a wallet. Here is what it covers and where the risk sits.

item.title: What is agentic trading? Authorised agents explained
item.description: Agentic trading means authorised agents act on a strategy within limits you set. Here is what you configure, what they can do, and who keeps authority.

item.title: LUX to OLV migration: for holders who already swapped
item.description: Lucent Network moved CLV holders to LUX in 2025. Olive now accepts LUX too, with no deadline set. Here is how the next step works for LUX holders.

item.title: Lucent Network status: LUX, the swap and what now
item.description: Lucent Network is the 2025 direction for CLV, with LUX on Solana and a swap window ending 17 July 2027. Here is where holders stand and what comes next.

item.title: CLV to OLV migration: what holders need to know
item.description: Olive is the successor to Clover Finance. All CLV holders can migrate to OLV, with no deadline set. Here is what the migration covers and how to start.

item.title: CLV migration status: open, no deadline, all holders
item.description: The Olive migration is open for CLV and LUX holders, with no deadline set as of 19 November 2026. Here is the current status and what to verify.

item.title: CLV migration scams: official links and red flags
item.description: Migrations attract impersonators. Here are the tactics used against CLV and LUX holders, the official Olive links, and what to do if something goes wrong.

item.title: CLV to Olive official links: verify before you send
item.description: The only official Olive links for the CLV and LUX migration, what each one is for, and how to spot a lookalike before you connect your wallet.

item.title: CLV migration: every path to Olive, explained
item.description: One page for the CLV and LUX migration to Olive. The paths, the assets, the eligibility, the official links, and the two migrations people confuse.

item.title: CLV migration eligibility: who can migrate to OLV
item.description: All CLV and LUX holders are eligible for the Olive migration, with no snapshot and no deadline set. Here is who it covers and what to prepare.

item.title: How to migrate CLV to Olive: a safe checklist
item.description: A step by step checklist for the CLV to OLV migration, from checking the official link to recording the transaction and confirming your OLV balance.

item.title: Clover Finance history: 2021 to the Olive era
item.description: Clover Finance launched in 2021, rebranded to CLV in 2022, and moved to Lucent Network in 2025. Here is the timeline and where holders stand today.
